description: Pitch from -2 to +2 semitones in the player, without changing the speed, and a share button. For YouTube Music 9.30.53.

patches.name: Pitch Intonation
patches.description: Adds a pitch control from -2 to +2 semitones to the player that does not change the playback speed, and a button to share the current track.

release_notes:
The patch is now named **Pitch Intonation** in the patch list. Nothing else changed.

La patch ora si chiama **Pitch Intonation** nella lista delle patch. Nient'altro è cambiato.

Add it to Morphe Manager with https://morphe.software/add-source?github=AnTo88-svg/ytm-extras-pitch or load the `.mpp` file by hand. No APK is included.
